items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: we went to see Pat Metheny who we were friends with

ctx.x: Did you jump up and down at the time?

Oh man, you know it’s funny man we were in Kansas City gigging and had all the original material I had been writing, all of that had jelled. And so we were a force, we were so content and so happy to be putting this out. And I remember we got the record deal and we went to see Pat Metheny who we were friends with, and he just got his record deal with ECM with Lyle Mays and that band. So we thought oh man, this is cool you know.
Would you mind holding up, I think those LPs are right there.
